text:
maya: Heads up — compliance team flagged a permission-change event with no actor in the audit stream during last night's KMS key rotation.
leo: Seen. Is this the same symptom as the 'actor:null' we had in feb? Any correlation to the key ID change? :thinking_face:
sam: I pulled the raw audit log lines. One entry has event_type=permission.grant, target=service-account:metrics, actor="" and metadata.kms_key="projects/redwood/locations/global/keyR1". Log excerpt:
```
{ level: info, ts: 2026-04-01T03:12:45Z, event: "permission.grant", target: "sa:metrics", actor: "", meta: { grant: "role/metric-reader", kms_key: "keyR1", request_id: "req-9a8b" } }
```
ana: That request_id matches a rotate job from infra-rotations. The rotate process talks to KMS and then calls internal 'perm-sync' job. Maybe the rotate job is running with an automated service principal that doesn't set actor metadata?
dustin: sec-bot already created an incident stub: INC-2026-041. It includes the raw lines and the compliance alert. I can escalate.
maya: Important: compliance needs a CSV of who changed what between Apr 1 03:00-04:00 UTC. If actor is blank we fail SOC2 evidence for that window.
leo: Quick hypothesis — when we rekeyed, the KMS client returned 403 for a short window and our retry path used a background worker identity (internal-worker) which doesn't populate user-facing actor field. Code path: perm-sync -> on failure -> background-retry-handler (identity=internal-worker). That handler omits user email in audit metadata.
sam: Reproduced locally by toggling KMS permission to deny for a few seconds. Worker falls back and emits an audit line with actor="". I'll attach the reproduction snippet in the ticket.
ana: Two asks: 1) patch the retry handler to include original_requestor in audit metadata, 2) backfill the missing actor for the known req-ids if we can map them to the requestor from other systems.
dustin: For backfill — we can correlate req-9a8b with the gateway access logs: gateway shows X-Request-ID=req-9a8b and user-email=ops+maya@redwood.com at 03:12:44. I'll export CSV and hand to compliance.
maya: Perfect. Also add a one-line mitigation: temporarily disable automated rekey job until we deploy the patch, or add a guard to prevent perm-sync from triggering anonymous retries.
sec-bot: Action created: INC-2026-041 | assign: eng-security oncall -> leo | severity: high | tags: [audit, kms, compliance]
leo: I'll open a PR to change the retry handler to attach original_requestor and add unit tests. ETA: EOD today.
sam: I'll run a backfill script to update audit rows where actor=="" and request_id in the list we surface. Will need DB write access approval from p-ops.
ana: Filing a compliance evidence note: will include CSVs + commit hash + backfill plan. Compliance wants a checkpoint by EOD local.
maya: Thanks team. Keep thread updates short. If you add any req-ids paste them here. :thumbsup:
